consent.title: Authorize access to your account?
consent.description: Review who is requesting access and which permissions will be granted before continuing.
consent.applicationIdentifierHelp: Identifier confirmed by the Authentication API.
consent.permissionsDescription: The application will only be able to perform the actions shown below.
consent.noAdditionalPermissions: No additional permission was included in this request.
consent.privacyNotice: Your password and session credentials will never be shared with the application.

openid.label: Confirm your identity
openid.description: Allows confirmation that you signed in with an Orthovet account.

profile.label: View basic profile information
profile.description: Allows access to basic data such as your name and public profile information.

email.label: View your email address
email.description: Allows access to the email address associated with your account.

offlineAccess.label: Maintain authorized access
offlineAccess.description: Allows the application to continue the authorized access while you are not using Orthovet.

other.description: Allows use of the “{scope}” permission associated with your account.

invalid.title: Invalid request
invalid.description: This authorization no longer exists or does not match the request that was started. Return to the application and try again.

expired.title: Request expired
expired.description: The time to review this authorization has ended. Return to the application to start a new request.

unavailable.title: Authorization unavailable
unavailable.description: We could not prepare this authorization right now. Please try again shortly.
